items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Einspruch ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich, schriftlich oder elektronisch beim Finanzamt Musterbergen; als Tag der Bekanntgabe eines einfachen Briefs gilt der vierte Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post.
items.computation: The letter carries two conflicting dates: the letterhead 'Datum' is 09.04.2027, but the body refers to 'diesem Bescheid vom 06.04.2027'. Using the earlier reading (posting day 06.04.2027, a Tuesday): under §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO deemed delivery is the 4th day after posting = Sat 10.04.2027; since that falls on a Saturday it shifts to the next business day, Mon 12.04.2027 (§108 Abs.3 AO / BFH IX R 68/98). Counting the one-month Einspruch period starts the following day (§187 Abs.1 BGB) and ends one month later, on Wed 12.05.2027 (§188 Abs.2 BGB), which is a normal working day so no further shift applies. (If the later letterhead date 09.04.2027 were instead the true posting day, the deadline would fall one day later, on 13.05.2027 — the earlier 12.05.2027 result is used given the contradiction.)

warnings: The letter gives two different dates for itself: the letterhead 'Datum' is 09.04.2027 while the text refers to 'diesem Bescheid vom 06.04.2027' — this inconsistency affects when the letter counts as delivered and hence the Einspruch deadline; the earlier date was used to compute the safer (earlier) due date, but the actual postmark should be checked.

This assessment sets interest of 46,00 € in the taxpayer's favour (Erstattungszinsen); it is not a payment demand, so there is normally little reason to object, but the standard Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung and its one-month period are still listed for completeness.
